letters.subject: Invoice BLS-1043: please confirm your VAT number
letters.body:
Hello,

Thank you for invoice BLS-1043, dated 22 October 2026, for £408.00. The VAT registration number shown, GB 618 7402 39, does not pass HMRC's check-digit test, so we can't reclaim the £68.00 VAT until it is confirmed.

Could you confirm your VAT registration number, please, by Friday 13 November? It may just be a typing error on the invoice.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd

letters.subject: Invoice CM-118377: £450.00 over PO-2611
letters.body:
Hello Neil,

Thank you for invoice CM-118377, dated 12 October 2026. It comes to £12,050.00 net, but our purchase order PO-2611 was agreed at £11,600.00, so the invoice is £450.00 over the order value.

Could you explain the extra charge or send a corrected invoice, please? A reply by Friday 13 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd

letters.subject: Invoice CIG-55190: total doesn't add up
letters.body:
Hello Lee,

Thank you for invoice CIG-55190, dated 14 October 2026. The net amount is £365.50 and the VAT is £73.10, which comes to £438.60, but the total due is shown as £483.60, a difference of £45.00.

Could you send a corrected invoice, please? A reply by Friday 13 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd
